## Decisions

- ⏳ **open** `qc-tablet-type-step` (Matt): The 48px quote size below 1280px is a raw value because the responsive heading tokens are viewport-scoped and the card sizes by container query. Add a container-scoped type token, or accept the Primitive exception? _Evidence: quote-card.css @container (max-width: 1279px); code evidence raw: line 119._
- ⏳ **open** `qc-button-tokens` (token pipeline): Button tokens: the slotted Button — v1 binds the shipped names (button/background/primary/solid/on-dark/default, button/content/primary/solid/inverse) while the code Button v2 references button-background-knockout-* names that are unshipped. _Evidence: quote-card.figma.evidence.json bindings on .content/.actions/Children/Button — v1; evals/tokens/out/homepage-tokens.json pipeline list._
- ⏳ **open** `qc-quote-ink` (Matt): The quote text binds content/default (theme-dependent) while the attribution binds content/knockout (invariant); on the media scrim both must read white. Code uses knockout for both. Should the design bind knockout on the quote too? _Evidence: quote-card.figma.evidence.json: .content/.quote/{heading} fills=s2a/color/content/default; Meta/Name and Meta/Role fills=s2a/color/content/knockout; explicit Dark mode only on the Mobile variant's .content._
- ⏳ **open** `qc-mobile-type` (Matt): At sm the component's heading-2 token resolves to 32px (five lines in the 292px mobile column), while the Home 375 page frame shows the quote near 48px and the code keeps 48. Which is the phone size of record? _Evidence: quote-card.figma.evidence.json variables heading-2 resolved {xl:56, lg:56, md:48, sm:32}; Home 375 8278:190566 crop; quote-card.css @container (max-width: 599px)._
- ✅ decided `qc-v2-anchor` (Matt): Which Figma set is the QuoteCard v2 successor, and when do the contract anchors move to it? → Located: QuoteCard — v2 is 13549:190801 (Breakpoint=Desktop|Mobile, no Context axis, Button — v2 in the slot, .footer wraps attribution + actions). Anchors stay on v1 (9334:3814) until the Homepage frames migrate; extract v2 evidence next so both are on file. _Evidence: quote-card.figma.evidence.json set.meta.changelog; get_metadata 11878:222771._
- ✅ decided `qc-mobile-geometry` (Claude): Mobile card is 327×542 at x=24 with a 16px peek and 8px gaps. → Decided from Home 375 spec 8278:190566; implemented 2026-09-15. _Evidence: evals/visual 375-light/social-proof-carousel; e2e mobile slide assertion._
- ✅ decided `qc-cta-style` (Claude): The CTA is always Button style=knockout. Should the style be a lever? → No: the card sits on media in both themes; knockout is the only readable style. Slot restricts to Button; style is fixed in code. _Evidence: quote-card.js createButton({ style: 'knockout' }); Figma .actions holds Button — v1 knockout._
- ✅ decided `qc-show-pagination` (Claude): The Figma card carries a Show Pagination boolean and a DotPagination instance (five dots: active content/knockout, inactive transparent/white/64, radius/round, size spacing/xs); in code the carousel owns pagination and the card has none. → Keep pagination in the carousel (one control for the track) and bind its dots to the same tokens the card's DotPagination uses. Show Pagination has no card-level code counterpart; recorded here rather than as a prop. _Evidence: quote-card.figma.evidence.json axes Show Pagination#9517:0 and .pagination bindings; social-proof-carousel.defs.json spc-dot-tokens._

## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `1.1.1`, `1.4.3`, `1.4.10`, `2.1.1`

- CTA is a native link; authoring validates its URL.
- Decorative media is aria-hidden. Do not use this component for meaningful diagrams or images requiring an accessible description.
- Content remains in flow so longer copy can grow the card rather than being clipped.
